blocks.text: 5. Sumkb. Bu-minem Sumkalar. Bu-minem. 6. Sumkb. Вu-beznen Sumkblar. Bu-Beznen

translations.en: 5. Bag. This-minem Bags. This-minem. 6. Bag. This-beznen Bags. This-Beznen

blocks.text: 7. Следующие фразы переведите на татарский язык:

translations.en: 7. Translate the following phrases into Tatar:

blocks.text: Это моя сумка, а та твоя сумка. В моей сумке твои книги, а в твоей сумке мои книги. Его книга не в моей сумке. Его книга в твоей сумке. Моя тетрадь у тебя, а твоя тетрадь у меня. Книга Тараса у нас. У нас не книга, а тетрадь Тараса. В классе нашего учителя нет, он нездоров.

translations.en: This is my bag, and that is your bag. My bag contains your books, and your bag contains my books. His book is not in my bag. His book is in your bag. You have my notebook, and I have your notebook. We have Taras's book. We don't have a book, we have Taras's notebook. Our teacher is not in the classroom; he is unwell.

blocks.text: Beznеn sыjnьf Bik zur. Beznеn sыjnьfta ike mic, ec işek həm dyrt tərəzə Bar. Ber mic un jaqta, ikence mic sul jaqta. Sul estinada Ber sǝojǝt, un estinada ike xarita Bar. Xaritalar janьnda Biş dijag- гam həm altь plakat Bar.

translations.en: The Beznen sıjnf is very big. In the Beznen sıjnf there are two scales, one for each animal and two scales. One for each scale is flour, the other for each scale is water. In the water column, there is a compass, and in the flour column, there are two maps. Next to the maps, there are five dijag- gams and six posters.
